mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.1% compresses discount rates and increases equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in accommodative monetary policy.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.1% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rates exceeding 5.5% signal economic weakness and reduced consumer spending, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to earnings contraction fears.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.5% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent housing starts below 1500 and GDP growth below 19000 indicate contraction in consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST < 1500 and GDPC1 < 19000 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 270) triggers anticipated Federal Reserve tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 270 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 1600 indicate weak residential construction demand, reducing sector growth expectations and driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST is below 1600 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 95 signals manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate output and profit margins, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO is below 95 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: High employment growth (PAYEMS growth > 0.5% monthly) supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS growth exceeds 0.5% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.1%) and high unemployment (UNRATE > 5.5%) indicate monetary policy accommodation for economic weakness, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.1 and UNRATE > 5.5 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).
